name: manual_dc81d8
claim: When a board note references a 'full report' file separate from its inline board summary, read the actual file before acting -- the inline summary is a compressed pointer, not a substitute

decisions.notes: User caught this directly this session after acting on a board-summary text alone; the full report file had file:line evidence, exact suggested code, and 3 open review questions the board summary compressed away entirely.
